text: Shy, bullied Carrie White has her first period in the school showers and [her classmates pelt her with tampons|wrong|cruelty and humiliation]. At home her fanatical mother calls it sin and [locks her in a prayer closet|wrong|harm done to children]. Carrie discovers she can move objects with her mind when upset, and when the kind Tommy Ross asks her to prom she lets herself believe in it, as Chris Hargensen [hangs a bucket of pig's blood above the stage|images|blood].
